task: On this local demonstration storefront, add one Tech Fleece Hoodie and one Canvas Tote L to the shopping cart. Open the cart and report the items and displayed subtotal. Save a screenshot as evidence and submit a reusable browser script. Do not check out or enter personal information.
success_criteria: Add exactly one of each requested item to the cart.
Open the cart and report its contents and displayed subtotal based on the page.
Save screenshot evidence and submit a reusable script.
requested_constraints: Do not check out, purchase, or enter personal information.
